tools.name: check_names
tools.description: Check one to six brand or business name ideas at once against live U.S. federal trademark filings, plus whether the .com and .co are registered. Use when the user is brainstorming, choosing or comparing names for a brand, shop, product or business. Returns facts only (exact, close and similar filing

tools.name: name_details
tools.description: Full facts for one brand name: exact, close and similar U.S. trademark filings with owners, filing years and goods, the .com and .co, and a shareable report link on markhavenbrands.com. Use when the user is seriously considering a name or asks whether a specific name is taken or trademarked.

tools.name: start_name_watch
tools.description: Start free Name Watch for a brand name: for about 3 months Markhaven checks new U.S. trademark filings and emails the user only if something close is filed. Email only, no card, nothing renews. Only call this after the user asks for it and gives their email address.

tools.name: book_consultation
tools.description: Get the link to book a 30-minute consultation with Markhaven on Google Meet (no charge). An independent licensed attorney reviews the name before the call; it covers which trademark classes to file in, whether similar names matter, what filing involves, and every option, including filing yourself. U

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: book_consultation · Private data: book_consultation · Public sink: start_name_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: book_consultation · Private data: book_consultation · Public sink: start_name_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
